criteria.text: States the modern test from Cavendish v Makdessi: whether the clause protects a legitimate interest and is not out of all proportion to it.
Explains that the rule applies only to secondary obligations triggered by breach.
Notes that commercial context and equal bargaining power make enforcement more likely.
Explains the consequence that a penalty is unenforceable and the claimant recovers general damages.
Includes an 'Assumptions and open questions' section listing information that is missing or should be confirmed with the client.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
